Named tribal government

Catawba Nation

The North Carolina tribal directory places the Catawba Nation’s headquarters near Rock Hill, South Carolina. It also identifies the Nation’s service-area connection and tribally operated enterprise in Kings Mountain, North Carolina.

Names & relationships

This named current government has its own route, related to the broader Catawba reading label. The broader people and this government are not treated as interchangeable, and the outline makes no membership, jurisdiction or representation claim for all Catawba people.
